messages.subject: Re: Hi Friends.
parts:
Welcome to R!  may it be your comfy home for many years.

A great place to start is the R website:

http://www.r-project.org/

And you can learn what R /is/ here:

http://www.r-project.org/about.html

But let me give you a quick tour.

R is a programming language (you write programs in it), a platform (which provides many useful tools to help you write programs), a community of programmers, academics, scientists and industrialists who use the R language and share programs, packages (sets of tools) and tips, and the occasional handshake.

It's best known for it's awesome package library - if you can think of a problem in the area of statistics, data processing, visualization any many more, it's probably been solved and turned into a ready made tool by someone already, and for it's sparkling graphics capabilities.  Edward Tufte, who literally *wrote the book* on data visualization, rates R as the most happening place to be for data display right now.

step right in, the water is warm.

-Alex
